items.new_text: In the Markdown editor, a table you did not touch is saved exactly as it was written, and a table you did change keeps its original column alignment, so the review shows only the rows that really differ.

In the Markdown editor, a table cell that contains a line break stays a normal Markdown table when saved, and the table under the cursor can be edited as plain Markdown text, with any problem shown before the change is applied.

Given a Markdown file with tables is open in the editor, when it is saved after edits, then a table you did not touch is saved exactly as it was written and a table you did change keeps its original column alignment, so the review shows only the rows that really differ.

Given a table cell contains a line break, when the file is saved from the editor, then the table stays a normal Markdown table, and when you choose to edit the table under the cursor as Markdown, then any problem is shown before the change is applied.
